about: kachat-names transaction vectors: CLI builders (tools/kachat-names-cli/src/ops.rs) on synthetic UTXOs, validated by rusty-kaspa a41a333's consensus validator. Signatures are random per run (secp256k1 aux randomness); everything else is deterministic.

name.layout: 0x20 key 0x20 name 0x20 owner 0x08 price 0x08 periodStart 0x08 expiresAt (126 bytes)
name.name: alice

inputLayouts.declineOffer: 0 offer.decline(sellerSig), alone; one output back to the buyer
inputLayouts.register: 0 gap.register(name, owner, salt, now, years, namePrefix, nameSuffix), 1 commit, 2.. funding; outputs 0 gap (lo,key), 1 gap (key,hi), 2 name, change

lockTimeRules.extend: lockTime 0, every input sequence 0; valid any time while expiresAt + years*periodMs <= periodStart + maxYears*periodMs
lockTimeRules.reclaim: lockTime = expiresAt + graceMs; every input sequence 0
lockTimeRules.register: lockTime = now = min(wallMs - 180000, blockTimeMs - 1000); commit input sequence = tCommit
lockTimeRules.renew: lockTime = max(min(wallMs - 180000, blockTimeMs - 1000), expiresAt - renewWindowMs) (unix ms, timestamp domain); every input sequence 0 (not u64::MAX: the CLTV needs a non-final input); final, so valid, only once the past median time (blockTimeMs) is above the lock time, i.e. once the window opened; a builder refuses before

KachatOffer.note: compiled for registryCovenantId with the pinned compiler library; scripts/build.sh writes the same bytes once params carry it

manifest.name: kachat-names
manifest.status: dry run: NOT broadcast, the registry does not exist

priceRules.tier: index = clamp(name length in bytes, 1, 5) - 1 into registerPrices / renewPrices (1, 2, 3, 4, 5+ chars)

registry: v4: fixed register and renew tables baked into KachatGap and KachatName (no price record), periodMs, offers bound to the seller (108 B state), decline
